No.-9911358 194). Offers of Established vendors with OFK or sister ordnance factories for the subj ect item shall be rejected during technical evaluation i.e. established sources shall n

ot be allowed to participate in SDOTE Bid. 2- Financial turn over criteria: The bidders to submit turn over certificate/balance she et/ITR duly certified by recognised chartered accountant for past 03 years as docume ntary evidence. MSE’s & Start-ups are exempted from financial turnover criteria subj ect to subject to meeting of quality & technical specifications and on submission of v alid Udyam Registration Certificate/ Certificate of Recognition. 3- If any firm is found as debarred for subject item at any stage before placing of sup ply order, offer of that firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 4- Capacity verification of the firm to be done to assess the capability through Video conferencing or physical verification at firm’s premises as decided by OFK. The price bid of only those firms will be considered for further course of action which will be recommended by capacity verification team as technically suitable. Bidders have to submit duly filled vendor registration form including all the required details & requisite documents for Capacity verification through vendor registration fa cility available at vendor.munitionsindia.in before tender opening date else its offer w ill not be considered. In case the online link does not work then the firm has to submit duly filled & signed VRRF including all the required details & requisite documents for Capacity verification along with the Bid else the offer of the Bidder will not be considered. Further the Bidd er also has to pay requisite application fee along with 18% GST for item registration t hrough online mode only and upload the payment receipt along with the Bid. The for mat of VRRF and payment details (i.e. fees amount & Bank account details) is availab le in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” section of the Bid Document. 5. Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP, Specification & D rawings as part of TE & Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent along with the Suppl y. The Material will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the So le Criteria for acceptance of the Item. Place of Inspection & Authority:- at O F Khamaria, Raw Material/Advance Sample/Bulk Quantity: CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative. 6. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the %age of local co ntent of material to be supplied. 7. Firm has to submit Earnest Money Deposit as Bid security as indicated in Tender E nquiry along with the Tender in favour of “Munitions India Limited O F KHAMARI A” as per GEM terms & conditions. The EMD may be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee fro m any of the commercial banks or payment online in an acceptable form. EMD is to be submitted by the bidders except Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) ha ving URC number as defined in MSE Procurement Policy 2012 issued by Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) or are registered with the Central Pur chase Organisation or the concerned Ministry or Department (including OFs) or Start- ups as recognised by Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP), irrespecti ve of the store for which they are registered. EMD is also not required from Central PS Us. Bidders/Sellers exempted from submission of EMD must submit certified copy of Govt of India authority for such exemption in lieu of EMD. EMD exemption for sellers will also be applicable as per latest GEM GTC. 8. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase preferen ce clause of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).

9. The firm already holding one SDOTE supply order is also not allowed to participate in other SDOTE for same item, floated by same or any other Factory. 10. Advance sample as per QAP/Drawing/specification. Within 60 days of placement of supply order the firm has to submit 20 nos. as advance sample for approval before bulk supply. 11. Performance Security Deposit is to be submitted by the supplier as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) is more than 05 Lakhs (within 30 d ays from the date of awarding of contract). PSD may preferably be submitted online t hrough SB Collect portal (link- “https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm ”. 12. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this complianc e statement completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 13. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uplo aded with bid: (i). I M/s. ....... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, s pecification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party d uring and after expiry of Contract. (ii). If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 14. A Model ECS Mandate Format is being uploaded with the Bid. The Bidders are req uested to submit this Mandate Format during tender finalization i.e. the firm has to s ubmit completely and correctly filled Mandate Format at the time of supplying the m aterial. 15. DP shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process involving raw material inspection, stage/final inspection before bulk supply as per drawing and specification. 16. Payment Terms- 100% payment within 30 days from the date of acceptance of m aterial at OFK premises. 17. QAP, Specification & Drawings shall not be uploaded in tender as same is confide ntial. Drawing, specification & QAP will be provided to firm after submission of non-di sclosure documents duly signed by firm through email: ofkpv4@ord.gov.in. 18. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’s hir ed labourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 220/ton from the regul ar bills of firm. Note:- Participating bidders may please note that Gem portal is having functionality t o monitor bids having same IP address used by bidders / sellers. Gem portal is captur ing and reflecting the IP address used by buyer and participated bidders / sellers. The received bids having matching / common IP address with other participating bidders / sellers or buyer, then their offer will be out rightly rejected and will not be consider ed for further evaluation . 7.
